card.name: Duration words after 'persisted'
card.fires_on: The word right after 'persisted' that introduces how long an effect lasted, mainly 'over' and 'for'. It is strongest in the NSAID post-MI death-risk passage.

modes.label: After persisted
modes.description: A preposition such as 'over' or 'for' follows 'persisted' and begins a time span.
modes.example: the increased relative risk of death in NSAID users persisted<< over>> at least the next four years of follow

modes.label: Other time or comparison words
modes.description: Occasional hits on 'the' after 'during' or on 'large' in a 'times as large' comparison.
modes.example: unlawful killings committed by security forces during<< the>> year. An overanxious police force

card.writes: It seems to push toward noun-like or label-like continuations and away from 'was/were' verbs.
card.plain: It marks the little word that begins a time span, as in a risk that 'persisted over' several years.
